title: FBI-UAP-D017, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-2, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: An artist's digital rendering (illustration), not a photograph — a visual interpretation of a reported UAP incident.
interpretation_warnings: This is an artist's rendering, not a photograph or sensor capture — every visual detail is interpretive and may not match the real event.
The image is based on a single first-hand witness account (a federal law enforcement special agent); it is single-source and unverified.
The underlying narrative lives in a separate document (DOW-UAP-D080), which would need to be read to assess the actual claims.
No source text was extracted from the file; all statements here derive from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the image or an accompanying report.
The rendering was produced in 2026, roughly three years after the reported 2023 event, adding distance between the account and the depiction.

key_facts.value: Digital rendering / artistic interpretation (not a photograph)
